reason: A browser-side DSH plugin that adds a draggable handle to resize the web composer while keeping the text view bottom-anchored.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页输入框添加拖拽把手，可调整输入框高度并在调整时保持文本底部可见。
summaries.en: Adds a draggable handle to the DeepSeek Harness web composer for adjusting its height while keeping the text view bottom-anchored.

capabilities: Modifies web composer layout and height
Injects client-side styles and resize controls
Observes UI mutations to reattach controls
